Ben / Rishi — I ran a quick sensitivity on the proposed numbers. If we recognize CloudLeaf as committed at the proposed net ($176,800) it reduces committed ARR for November by ~$83k vs list; that is material for our month close. A couple of asks from Finance before we reclass to committed:

1) A formal Deal Desk approval email thread documenting the approval level and approver name (Rishi, please confirm).
2) Evidence of payment terms / PO or signed purchase order or signed SOW + DocuSign executed contract. We cannot treat unsigned or contingent PO commitments as committed revenue.
3) If approval is >30% (which this is), we will need a brief note from Sales leadership confirming strategic rationale (customer expansion, reference value) and confirming added deal protections (e.g., clawback terms or staged payments).

If those items are not in place by EOD Friday (11/5) for forecasting lock, move the opportunity in HubSpot to "Best Case" (or equivalent non-committed bucket) for the current close. We can reclassify for the next lock cycle once approvals and signatures are in place.

Rishi — please prioritize this in the Deal Desk queue; Ben, please push procurement for PO timeline and expedite DocuSign. Laura / Vivek — if you can drop a short comment in the HubSpot deal record with the decision, that will make the Friday lock audit cleaner.
